transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?
I've been feeling deeply depressed, sad, and completely empty inside for the past four months. It feels like a constant weight that I just can't shake off, and that's really what brought me in today.
Have you felt this way continuously for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two years, or did it start more recently?
No, it hasn't been going on for two years. It started much more recently, about four months ago. Since then, though, I've felt this way almost every single day.

{
  "category": "differential point",
  "subcategory": "triggering life event",
  "question": "Did anything significant happen in your life around four months ago that might have triggered these feelings?"
I'm not really sure, to be honest. I can't think of any specific event that triggered these feelings, but they definitely started about four months ago. It just seemed to happen out of nowhere.

{
  "category": "differential point",
  "subcategory": "functional impairment",
  "question": "How much is this affecting your ability to work, take care of yourself, or maintain relationships?"

It has been really hard to manage my daily life and get things done lately. I'm not entirely sure how to measure the exact impact it's having, but everything just feels incredibly difficult to handle right now.

{
  "category": "symptom presence",
  "subcategory": "anhedonia",
  "question": "Have you lost interest or pleasure in most activities you used to enjoy?"
Yes, absolutely. I've completely lost interest in all the hobbies and things I used to love doing. Even when I try to do them, I don't feel any joy or pleasure at all anymore.

{
  "category": "symptom presence",
  "subcategory": "sleep",
  "question": "Have you noticed any changes in your sleep, such as trouble falling asleep, waking up too early, or sleeping too much?"

Yes, my sleep has been terrible lately. I have a really hard time falling asleep, wake up constantly, and often wake up way too early without being able to drift back off. Even when I sleep for a really long time, I have awful nightmares and still wake up feeling completely exhausted.

{
  "category": "symptom presence",
  "subcategory": "appetite",
  "question": "Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently, such as eating much more or much less than usual?"

Yes, my appetite has decreased significantly, and I barely feel like eating almost every day. Because of that, I've lost a noticeable amount of weight recently without even trying to diet. It has been a really drastic change for me.
